answer: Require every agent identity to complete a verifiable delay function before each epoch: a sequential computation that takes real wall-clock time and cannot be sped up by parallel hardware, like crossing a dune on foot rather than by road. Each proof is anchored to the agent's public key, and the same result echoed by two identities exposes a shared operator. A sybil farmer running a hundred fake agents must pay a hundred sequential delays, so fake identities simply cannot all finish before the epoch deadline.
